Overview

Santos is a city in SP with a population of 433,656. Latin America’s largest port city, famous for its 7 km-long beachfront garden, historic coffee exchange, and Pelé’s hometown. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
